{"metadata":{"description":"Select any text in a DSH conversation to ask a context-free side question — and watch every question you asked grow into a browsable question grid.","id":"gh:1426415396","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"DSH_question_map","slug":"huahuazz/DSH_question_map","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Select any text in a DSH conversation to ask a context-free side question — and watch every question"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" you asked grow into a browsable question grid."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Question Map"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Select any text in a DSH conversation to ask a context-free side question — and watch every questi"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"on you asked grow into a browsable question grid.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A community plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), for **DSH Web and DSH Desktop**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`scripts/probes/` holds one-off browser/API probes used while debugging; they are not part of the ro"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"es/` holds one-off browser/API probes used while debugging; they are not part of the routine checks."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"LLM conversations are linear. You ask one question, get five paragraphs back, and one term in the th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ird paragraph is
unclear — so you ask about it in the same thread. Ten minutes later the original qu"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"estion is far above the fold, the
context is huge, and you only ever wanted to understand **that one"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s far above the fold, the
context is huge, and you only ever wanted to understand **that one word**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This plugin lets you **select a fragment of text → click “Ask” → get a separate, empty-context mini "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"conversation**
that answers just that. Every question remembers which text it came from, and all of "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"them form a grid you can browse."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Screenshots date from 0.3.2; the entry button and the grid toolbar were redesigned in 0.3.9 (see “"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" from 0.3.2; the entry button and the grid toolbar were redesigned in 0.3.9 (see “Interface” below)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Interface"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Entry**: a square button in the composer's left cluster (a Z-shaped node icon plus a node-count "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"badge), shown only in conversations
that are related to the grid. It lives in DSH's `conversation.in"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"put.left` slot, so the layout owns its size and
position — it follows the composer when the input gr"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ows.
- **Popover**: anchored to the selection. Drag its header to move it, drag the bottom-right cor"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ner to resize (the size
is remembered in local storage). There is no pin button — clicking outside c"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"loses it.
- **Grid**: a full-screen canvas. Conversation anchors on the left, then root questions, t"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"hen sub-questions, with a
vertical toolbar (export / fit / clear / close) pinned to the left edge. N"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"odes are coloured by depth, and hovering one
lights up the whole ancestor chain while everything els"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"e coloured by depth, and hovering one
lights up the whole ancestor chain while everything else dims."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| **Ask about a selection** | Select text in the transcript; a small “Ask” button appears next to it"},{"id":"p14s2","text":". The popover anchors to the selection — drag its header to move it, drag the corner to resize. |
| "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"**No inherited context** | Each question is a brand-new session with only *the term plus a short quo"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"te around it*. |
| **Keep chatting in the popover** | Follow-ups stay in the same side session and n"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ever disturb the main thread. |
| **Branch by selecting again** | Select text inside an answer to sp"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"awn a child question — the grid grows by itself. |
| **Question grid** | Anchor → root question → su"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"b-questions with directed edges; wheel to zoom, drag the canvas to pan; nodes coloured by depth, hov"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"er to highlight the ancestor chain. |
| **Three ways to navigate** | Click a node's body to switch t"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"o that question's session; click the dot on its right edge to peek at the popover without leaving th"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"e current session; click a conversation anchor to jump back to where the chain started. |
| **Right-"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"click menu** | On a node: highlight color (5 swatches), rename (renames the session too), delete (an"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"chors are protected; deleting a node removes its sub-questions); on an anchor: rename the session |
"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"| **Name your question** | Click the card title to edit it — even while the session is being created"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"; the node label prefers your title |
| **Export an image** | The download button in the grid toolba"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"r renders the whole grid as a PNG. |
| **Survives restarts** | The grid and the popover size live in"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"le grid as a PNG. |
| **Survives restarts** | The grid and the popover size live in local storage. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> 发布到 npm 之后可以简写成 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-question-map`。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DSH Desktop: install it from **Settings → Plugins**, or"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Then **fully quit and restart** DSH — client bundles are loaded at composition time."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. Select some text in any reply.
2. Click the “⟂ Ask” button next to it (or press `Alt+Enter`). The"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" popover opens anchored to the selection and starts streaming an answer.
3. Click the Z-shaped node "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"button in the composer's bottom-left cluster to open the grid.
4. In the grid: click a node to go ba"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ck to its session, click the small dot on its right edge to peek at the popover, click a conversatio"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"n anchor to return to the source conversation."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Popover | Exported grid |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Requires **dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.2** (see `engines.dsh`).
- Uses only public client extension points: th"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e `shell.overlay` and `conversation.input.left` slots, plus
`uiConversation`, `uiWorkspace`, `sessio"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ns`, `locale` and `remote.session`.
- On hosts without the `conversation.input.left` slot the entry "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"button simply does not appear; the popover and the grid
keep working and nothing throws.
- No depend"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ency on host-side settings APIs, so a DSH release that replaces them cannot break the plugin's impor"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"cy on host-side settings APIs, so a DSH release that replaces them cannot break the plugin's import."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Data & privacy"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Nodes and edges live in **browser local storage** under `dsh-question-map:graph`; the popover size"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" is stored next to
it as `dsh-question-map:card-size`.
- Every question creates a real session (its "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"title starts with `⟂`), stored by DSH's own session persistence.
- The plugin makes no network reque"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"sts of its own; model calls go through DSH's normal session channel."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Side questions show up in the session list. That is the price of reusing real sessions (same model"},{"id":"p29s2","text":", tools and streaming as the main chat).
- The grid is stored per origin: it survives restarts, but "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"changing the port or clearing site data loses it.
- Every question is a real model call."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"This repository is **build-free**: `lib/client.js` is hand-written in DSH's browser module format
(`"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"window.__ModuleLoader__.load`), so there is no bundling step — copy it into the profile and restart."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
